findings.claim: The round-3 pedagogy repair is recorded as closing the batch's open G-STEM major structural-leak flag on q:2, and asserts "Blind, only C is now heuristically eliminable, leaving three live options." That claim is false. G-STEM named two specific non-derivable predicates as the elimination mechanism (a cost-per-route trend, a municipal walkability judgement); the rewritten B and D still carry exactly those two predicates, so the blind path G-STEM described is intact. The unit's own shipped rationales eliminate B and D on precisely those grounds. G-STEM was never re-run on the rewritten options, so the closure rests entirely on the editing stage's own unverified self-assessment.
findings.evidence: G-STEM finding (verdicts/verdicts-gstem.jsonl, target q:2, verdict flag, severity major): "Stem-fit alone, with no domain knowledge, eliminates B and D: overlaying pupil addresses on timetables cannot yield a cost-per-route trend or a municipal walkability judgement. C is then the sole absolute quantifier ('Ingen av de tjugotre'), leaving A." CURRENT shipped options for q:2: B = ”De turer som har flest skjutsberättigade elever ombord är också de som kostar kommunen mest.” (still a cost ranking between turer); D = ”De flesta av de berörda eleverna bor längs vägsträckor som kommunen har bedömt som olämpliga att gå längs.” (still a municipal walkability judgement); C = ”Ingen av de tjugotre morgonturerna skulle gå att korta om gränsen höjdes.” (still the sole absolute quantifier). The unit's OWN shipped q:2 rationale eliminates both on stem-fit: for B, ”…är inget som adressgenomgången kunde visa: den lade adresser ovanpå turlistor och gav ingen kostnadsrangordning mellan turerna”; for D, ”uppgiften om olämpliga vägsträckor kommer från kommunens trafiksäkerhetsbedömning i stycke 5, inte från adressgenomgången”. If B is eliminable, at most A and D survive a blind read, i.e. two options, not the three claimed. Re-gate evidence: verdicts/verdicts-gstem.jsonl mtime 2026-08-26 12:52:46 predates candidates-final/las-b16-002.json (13:33:26) by 41 minutes, and verdicts-vfinal/ contains only verdicts-gkey-1/2 and verdicts-gdistractor — no G-STEM re-run exists for the rewritten options.
findings.why: Whether a test-wise student can score without reading is the pedagogy stage's core construct-validity question, and this is the batch's only open major flag on this unit. Recording it as remediated on the strength of an unverified self-assessment, when the named mechanism survives verbatim in kind and the unit's own rationales confirm it, is above the MINOR_FIXES band the stage recorded.

findings.claim: The shipped generator_meta.repair_log contains a direct self-contradiction between round 3 and round 4 about q:2 option B, and the round-4 integrated sweep - which authored the contradicting text and whose explicit mandate is the whole-unit self-contradiction check - did not record it. Round 3 rewrote B specifically so that it could NOT be discarded on stem-fit alone; round 4 then repaired the rationale by discarding B on stem-fit alone, silently undoing round 3's stated purpose without noting the conflict.
findings.evidence: repair_log round 3 (by pedagogy-review), edit note for questions[q_index=2].options[B].text: "…now phrased as something the address overlay could in principle show, so it can no longer be discarded on stem-fit alone." Same ticket: "B and D are rewritten so that all four options are overlay-shaped findings" and "Blind, only C is now heuristically eliminable, leaving three live options." repair_log round 4 (by integrated-review/opus), edit note: "refutes B where it actually fails: the stem asks what the address overlay showed, and an overlay of adresser on turlistor yields no cost ranking", and the shipped rationale text it installed: ”…är inget som adressgenomgången kunde visa: den lade adresser ovanpå turlistor och gav ingen kostnadsrangordning mellan turerna.” Round 4's own not_done section records two other cross-consistency notes (the stycke-6 / distractor-C tension and the self_blind_solve q:1-vs-q:2 misattribution) but is silent on this one, and its verification section does not revisit round 3's stem-fit claim.
findings.why: "A rationale that no longer matches an edited option" and "no self-contradiction" are the integrated stage's stated remit. Here the contradiction is not merely between metadata entries: the shipped teaching payload asserts the very eliminability the immediately preceding repair round certified as removed, which is what leaves the q:2 leak open. MINOR_NOTES understates a defect the stage introduced and passed over.

findings.claim: The q:2 rationale's C motivation misreports the passage: it substitutes 'turer' for the passage's 'fordonen', adds a quantifier hedge the passage does not have, and frames C as an overgeneralisation of a predicate (’står kvar’) that is not the predicate C asserts (’gå att korta’).
findings.evidence: Rationale (q:2, C motivation): ”C är overgeneralisation: adressgenomgången visar att de allra flesta turerna står kvar oavsett var gränsen dras, men C skärper det till att inte en enda tur skulle gå att korta…”. Passage stycke 3 says only: ”Fordonen står alltså kvar oavsett var gränsen dras.” — fordon, not turer, and unhedged. Per the passage no tur is withdrawn at all (”Tjugotre turer avgår varje morgon”; only the two avstickare could be struck), so ”de allra flesta turerna” implies some turer do not remain, which the text never says. The refutation that follows (”två stickvägar … som skulle gå att stryka ur turplaneringen”) is correct and carries the item.
findings.why: Rationale-to-passage fidelity is the integrated stage's re-quote check, and its round-4 verification explicitly re-checked the q:2 motivations. The teaching payload still reaches the right answer, so this is minor rather than verdict-flipping on its own, but it is a factual slip in a rationale the stage certified as reconciled.
